title: Angle Sum Property
description: The sum of the interior angles of a triangle is always 180 degrees.

example.question: Two angles are 65° and 45°. Find the third angle.

title: Exterior Angle Theorem
formula: Exterior Angle = Sum of Opposite Interior Angles
description: An exterior angle equals the sum of the two opposite interior angles.

example.question: Opposite interior angles are 45° and 55°. Find the exterior angle.

title: Area of Triangle
description: Calculates the area of a triangle.

example.question: Find the area of a triangle with base 10 cm and height 8 cm.

note: Height must be perpendicular to the base.

title: Heron's Formula
description: Calculates the area when all three sides are known.

example.question: Find the area of a triangle with sides 3,4,5.

title: Pythagoras Theorem
description: Relates the sides of a right triangle.

example.question: Find the hypotenuse if the other sides are 6 cm and 8 cm.

title: Area of Equilateral Triangle
description: Calculates the area of an equilateral triangle.

example.question: Find the area when side = 8 cm.

title: Height of Equilateral Triangle
description: Calculates the height of an equilateral triangle.

example.question: Find the height if side = 10 cm.

title: Perimeter of Triangle
description: Calculates the perimeter of a triangle.

example.question: Find the perimeter of a triangle with sides 5,6,7 cm.
